headline: Salabask
title: Salabask | Swamp Support Starter | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Salabask is a stage one Grass and Water Aniimo that can swim. It evolves into Crocobask at level sixty two with one Sprout Stone. Gatorjaw Bite has power thirty and an eighteen second cooldown. Spring Renewal costs twenty energy and recharges every thirty seconds. Homeland work is Grass, Water and Hauling at level one. It is a calm starter pick for beginners. Would you raise a Salabask? Comment below!
description: Salabask guide: a stage 1 Grass and Water Aniimo that evolves into Crocobask at Lv. 62 with a Sprout Stone. Gatorjaw Bite, Spring Renewal and Grass, Water and Hauling Homeland work. Checked on aniimo.gg and metabot.gg in November 2026.
joke: Salabask looks like driftwood, so please do not use it as a bridge.
